title.en: An Act Amending Subsection (I) of Section One Hundred and Forty-Two of Act Numbered Eleven Hundred and Eighty-Nine, Known as the "Internal-Revenue Law of Nineteen Hundred and Four," By Including Manufacturers Within Its Provisions and Changing the Basis of the Exemption therein Provided, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Subsection (i) of section one hundred and forty-two of Act Numbered Eleven hundred and
eighty-nine, commonly known as the "Internal-Revenue Law," is hereby amended to read as follows:
" (i) Merchants, peddlers, manufacturers, and small booth the gross value of whose quarterly sales does not S"
exceed one hundred and twenty-five pesos."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 11, 1913.
